blocks.text: Before money becomes numbers, it becomes behavior.
If your salary comes on the 1st and vanishes by the 15th, this page is for you.
We are not here to sell you insurance. We are here to fix the operating system in your head.
"Paisa haath ka mail hai" (Money is dirt). Yet, everyone panics when it's gone.
Money is Stored Energy. It is your time and effort frozen into a number. If you waste money, you are burning your own life hours.

Income: The river (Salary, Rent).
Wealth: The Dam (Assets, FD, Stocks).
High Salary + Zero Assets = Poor with an iPhone.
blocks.title: Income vs Wealth

blocks.text: Society rewards appearance, not stability. You buy things to impress people you don't even like.

items: 🚗 Wants (Disguised): "Car is required for status", "New phone for work", "Grand wedding for parents".

blocks.text:
EMI isn't affordability. It is future income spent today.
Buying a sofa on EMI? You just sold your freedom for foam.
blocks.title: 💀 The EMI Disease

blocks.text: Any loan taken for a depreciating asset or lifestyle. It steals from your future.
🚗 Car Loan 📱 iPhone EMI 💍 Personal Loan
A loan that increases your income or net worth over time. Ideally, someone else pays it off.
🎓 Education Loan 🏭 Business Loan 🏠 Rental Property

Paying only the minimum due lets interest continue to accrue. The rate and charges depend on the card issuer and your agreement; check the card’s current terms and try to pay the full statement balance.
💳 Revolving Credit 🎰 BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later)

sections.heading: Debt: The Good, The Bad, The Ugly

blocks.text: We save for Marriages and Gold (Emotion), but ignore Inflation and Emergencies (Logic).

This is not "Savings". This is Survival Money.
- Amount: 6 Months of Expenses (Rent + Food + EMI).
- Location: Liquid Fund or Separate Bank Account.
- Rule: Do not touch unless you lose your job or land in a hospital.
blocks.title: 🛡️ The Emergency Fund Rule

blocks.text: If you live in it, it takes money out of your pocket (Maintenance, Tax, EMI). It's a Liability.
A car is a useful asset that usually depreciates over time. The rate depends on the model, condition, use, and resale market; it is not a fixed immediate loss.

Jewellery can include making charges and resale deductions. Compare the full purchase and resale terms. A Sovereign Gold Bond, a gold ETF, and app-based digital gold are different products with different risks.
Some assets may generate income or appreciate over time, but each has costs and risks. Choose based on your goals, time horizon, and ability to absorb losses.

items: ✅ Buy Term Insurance (Before it gets expensive).
✅ Review EPF and PPF as separate products; their contribution, withdrawal, and tax rules differ. Check the current rules before choosing.
🚫 Don't raid retirement funds for kids' education.

blocks.text: You are getting poorer silently. This is called Lifestyle Inflation.
CPI tracks a defined basket of household goods and services. Your personal cost changes depend on your own spending mix; school, healthcare, and food costs may move differently.
💭 Think: What did a Samosa cost 10 years ago? What does it cost now?
Illustrative index only; these values are not official CPI data or a measured household sample.
"If I earn more, I will save more."
Reality: Parkinson’s Law. As income rises, your expenses will rise to match it immediately. You stay broke at a higher level.
Reality: Invest 20% the moment salary hits. Spend whatever is left. Wealth is what you don't see (Investments), not what you show (Gadgets).
Reality: You buy things you don't need, with money you don't have, to impress people you don't even like. Status games have no winners.
Reality: You only hear about their wins, never their losses. Investing based on excitement is gambling. Boring is profitable.
Reality: The happiness of a new purchase lasts 48 hours. The pain of the EMI lasts 12 months. Choose your pain wisely.
